references.title: DWDS: Reiter
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for die Reiter (Femininum, DWDS 2024), 'Synonym zu Sieb'

references.title: Wiktionary: Reiter
references.supports: Etymology 2: from MHG rītere, OHG rîtera 'sieve' (glossing Latin cribrum), from Proto-West-Germanic *hrīdrā, not from reiten

notes.rationale: The sieve, die Reiter. DWDS gives this homograph no Wortzerlegung, and its -er is no suffix: it goes back to OHG rîtera 'sieve', unrelated to reiten. So it is a bottom word: the Root reiter and the zero ending (ADR 0051). der Reiter, the rider, splits reiten + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split).
